# @superslate/avatar

> Open-source, zero-dependency soft gradient SVG avatar generator by Superslate (https://superslate.dev).

## Links

- Live Studio: https://superslate.dev/avatars/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/superslate-dev/avatar
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superslate/avatar
- Superslate SaaS Boilerplate: https://superslate.dev/
- Live Read-Only Demo: https://app.superslate.dev/

## Features

- 6 shape families: bloom, silk, flare, nova, void, jade
- 40 curated 9-token color palettes
- Dedicated light and dark appearances with OKLCH delta transfer
- Global OKLCH tone controls (hue, relative chroma, lightness)
- Deterministic geometry drift via variantId
- Optional grapheme-safe initials overlay (up to 2 clusters)
- Core SVG API, optional React component (@superslate/avatar/react), and CLI
- MIT license, zero runtime dependencies
